results.title: Fix a k8s manifest that fails validation

steps_log.output:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: web
spec:
  replicas: "2"
  selector:
    matchLabels: { app: web }
  template:
    metadata:
      labels: { app: web }
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: nginx
          image: nginx:1.27

STDERR: Warning: Permanently added '192.168.2.175' (ED25519) to the list of known hosts.

/tmp/nd/k8s/deploy.yaml - Deployment web is invalid: problem validating schema. Check JSON formatting: jsonschema: '/spec/replicas' does not validate with https://raw.githubusercontent.com/yannh/kubernetes-json-schema/master/master-standalone/deployment-apps-v1.json#/properties/spec/properties/replicas/type: expected integer or null, but got string

STDERR: Warning: Permanently added '192.168.2.175' (ED25519) to the list of known hosts.

(exit code: 1)
STDERR: Warning: Permanently added '192.168.2.175' (ED25519) to the list of known hosts.

VALIDATION PASSED

STDERR: Warning: Permanently added '192.168.2.175' (ED25519) to the list of known hosts.

apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: web
spec:
  replicas: 2
  selector:
    matchLabels: { app: web }
  template:
    metadata:
      labels: { app: web }
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: nginx
          image: nginx:1.27

STDERR: Warning: Permanently added '192.168.2.175' (ED25519) to the list of known hosts.

steps_log.content: Fixed. The issue was that `replicas` was specified as a string (`"2"`) instead of an integer (`2`). Changed it to `replicas: 2` and the manifest now validates successfully.
